mapper.insert: INSERT INTO range_trade_order_log (symbol, side, reason, dry_run, requested_qty, requested_price, toss_order_id, success, message, commission, tax, entry_price, created_at) VALUES (#{symbol}, #{side}, #{reason}, #{dryRun}, #{requestedQty}, #{requestedPrice}, #{tossOrderId}, #{success}, #{message}, #{commission}, #{tax}, #{entryPrice}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT id, symbol, side, reason, dry_run, requested_qty, requested_price, toss_order_id, success, message, commission, tax, entry_price, created_at FROM range_trade_order_log ORDER BY created_at DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(commission, 0) + COALESCE(tax, 0)), 0) FROM range_trade_order_log WHERE success = 1
